content.text: Let me look at the save mutation to see how it updates the cache after a save.

The list page must be reading from a separate cached query that this mutation never touches. I'll patch the list's cache entry directly here so a save updates it the same way the detail view already does.

content.text: Fixed. The post list page reads its own cached query, and the save mutation only ever wrote the detail cache, so the list kept showing stale data until something else refetched it. I added a second setQueryData call to the save mutation's onSuccess that patches the matching entry in the list's own cached array with the saved fields, so the list reflects a save immediately without waiting for a refetch. Existing tests, lint, and format checks all pass.
